an7.4:1.3: saddhābalaṃ, viriyabalaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, paññābalaṃ. (1)
an7.4:2.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ:
an7.4:2.3: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
an7.4:3.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako āraddhaviriyo viharati: akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an7.4:4.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako hirimā hoti, hirīyati kāyaduccaritena, vacīduccaritena, manoduccaritena, hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an7.4:5.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako ottappī hoti, ottapati kāyaduccaritena, vacīduccaritena, manoduccaritena, ottapati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an7.4:6.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
an7.4:8.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
